More likely it's somehow incompatible with your system. Could be graphics driver related or anything really. If you haven't already, you could try downloading the source code and compiling it yourself.

If you feel like looking into the segmentation fault, you can find the core dump with coredumpctl list and get a little info with coredumpctl info pid, where pid is the number on the Godot line. For details you need to install the GNU debugger (gdb) and run coredumpctl gdb pid with the same PID number. That gives you a prompt where you can print the backtrace with the bt command. That might give you some hint on what causes the crash.
